title: Macro insert - the cheapest shot you can make
prompt: no humans, extreme close-up, soccer ball on wet grass, water droplets, shallow depth of field, object focus, floodlight rim light, masterpiece, best quality, very aesthetic, absurdres
why: No character, no face, no consistency risk, near-perfect prompt adherence, about 4.5s of GPU. One insert per act minimum, and make it an object - this is also how you fake coverage, since no model here has a persistent 3D space to cut around.
